messages:
diego: Quick heads up - pushed runtime 4.0 and SDK 3.2 to canary ~15m ago. Canary flagged a compatibility blip: routes that pin a model version explicitly are getting a schema mismatch when the SDK negotiates model_variant metadata.

asma: saw it too. Error = `model_variant_mismatch` when route has model_pin set and SDK 3.2 appends variant metadata field `variant_tag`. Only hits quantized llama families.

elena: Possible causes: runtime changed variant field name or SDK 3.2 changed naming. We need a low-blast mitigation. Options: (A) apply a targeted model pin back to 3.x for affected routes, (B) apply an SDK pin to 3.1 for those routes, (C) deploy a small adapter that accepts both fields. Thoughts?

diego: Prefer C + targeted SDK pin for prod cohorts until adapter lands. Adapter is small: lookup both `variant_tag` and legacy `variant`. I'll open PR.

deploybot: canary summary: https://deploys.redwood/canaries/2819000001 — overall green except pinned-routes cohort showing 2.9% `model_variant_mismatch`.

asma: I'll prepare a pin request for SDK 3.1 against cohorts: `pin-cohort:pinned-route-*` and `embed-stable-*`. Criteria: apply to prod if mismatch >1% sustained for 5m.

elena: add explicit rollback/runbook criteria in the pin record: trigger rollback if error-rate >=5% OR customer-facing 5xx rate increases by 1% absolute. Also add communication note for release-notes: "If you pin models and rely on model_variant metadata, SDK 3.2 introduces `variant_tag` which may be incompatible with some pinned runtimes. Pin to SDK 3.1 as a workaround."

diego: PR opened: https://git.redwood/runtime/pulls/8000 — adapter accepts both fields and adds a unit test for pinned routes. Small change.

deploybot: SDK pin applied to cohort `pinned-route-prod` at 2819000600 by @asma. Pin metadata (dashboard): sdk: "3.1.9", routes: ["pinned-route-*","embed-stable-*"], reason: "SDK 3.2 variant metadata name change -> model_variant_mismatch", owner: "eng-sdk".

docs-bot: Drafted release-note blurb and customer comms skeleton: https://docs.redwood/release-notes/drafts/2819000001-compat.md

asma: Monitoring plan: run overlay traffic at 5% for 30m, check `model_variant_mismatch` and 5xxs every 1m. If mismatch >3% for 10m escalate to incidents and trigger unpin/rollback.

elena: If adapter passes canary we'll remove SDK pin and ship adapter in next minor runtime patch. Keep support template in docs for customers who hit the error.

diego: TL;DR: SDK pin applied to affected prod cohorts, adapter PR open and testing on canary, rollback thresholds + release note drafted. Will update in 30m after overlay metrics.
